tasks.title: Probe keeps startup coverage with eight process tests under the CPU limit
tasks.spec: ## Repository: probe, all change bullets, Checks and Completion evidence; Performance impact measurement command; Security impact; Counterexamples (probe removal and no test.skip); Acceptance evidence 1. Delete the 14 specified duplicate spawn cases, preserve the eight specified process tests including invalid UTF-8 and PULSE_API_URL, and add the in-process EISDIR case with the exact sanitized message through startupMessage. Keep every removed behavior assertion covered in-process; leave production code, budgets and coverage settings unchanged.

acceptance.expected: 8 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip: one bad PULSE_API_URL, occupied health port, SIGTERM, healthz/metrics/shutdown, token-file success, ENOENT, invalid UTF-8 token content, and private-range end-to-end test. Each starts one child. The invalid UTF-8 test checks exit 2, one sanitized error line and no SENTINEL in stdout or stderr. A focused run may fail the full-suite coverage threshold; its test results are the acceptance here.

0 fail, 0 skip; the added failingReader/FakeFsError EISDIR case with a SENTINEL-bearing error message and PULSE_PROBE_TOKEN_FILE=/dir yields exactly PULSE_PROBE_TOKEN_FILE=/dir: cannot read (EISDIR), with no SENTINEL. Existing in-process token assertions still pass. A focused run may fail the full-suite coverage threshold.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with 0 fail, 0 skip and line coverage at least 80 %.

acceptance.command: git rev-parse HEAD && bun --version && lscpu && for sample in 1 2 3 4 5; do bun -e 'const p = Bun.spawn(["bun", "run", "test"], { stdout: "ignore", stderr: "ignore" }); const code = await p.exited; const u = p.resourceUsage(); console.log(code, ((Number(u.cpuTime.user) + Number(u.cpuTime.system)) / 1e6).toFixed(2))'; done
acceptance.expected: Run separately on clean main 8260148 (or current main) and branch head, on the same EPYC 7763-class runner with Bun 1.4.0. Each side supplies 5 samples, each reporting test exit code 0. The branch median (3rd smallest of 5) is at most 2.20 s. If it exceeds 2.20 s, request needs-input with the samples; do not cut further tests or raise a budget.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && git diff --name-only <base-sha> HEAD && git diff <base-sha> HEAD -- src/main.test.ts src/token.test.ts
acceptance.expected: exit 0; only src/main.test.ts and src/token.test.ts change. Exactly 14 duplicate process tests are deleted, none are skipped, and one EISDIR in-process case is added. The retained token-content and bad-setting cases preserve secret redaction. No production code, dependency, Dockerfile, CI, budget or coverage configuration changes.

acceptance.command: gh pr checks <pr-number> --repo lorenzh/pulse-probe && gh pr view <pr-number> --repo lorenzh/pulse-probe --json body --jq .body
acceptance.expected: All required CI checks pass, including shared lint/typecheck/test and Docker checks. The PR body names #585, lists the 8 retained spawn tests and every deleted test with its in-process twin (file:line), and gives both SHAs, CPU model, Bun version, 5 CPU samples and median per side, branch median at most 2.20 s, coverage at least 80 %, commands/results and known limits.
